name: labs/benpruitt__tecancavro
title: Tecan Cavro XCalibur D syringe pump
intro: Tecan Cavro XCalibur D syringe pump, adapted from benpruitt/tecancavro. It reads `plunger_position`, `encoder_position`, `port` and `buffer_status`; sets `start_speed`, `top_speed`, `cutoff_speed`, `microstep` and 2 more; runs `move_plunger`, `dispense` and `stop_pump`. `move_plunger`: move the plunger to an absolute position and execute the queued command. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
